alternatives.title: Pip contact and consequence
alternatives.text: Pip the rabbit reaches for a toy cabinet with a sticky note. The note clings to Pip's finger instead. Peeling splits it into one note per hand. Each pull doubles the notes from two to four to eight. Pip sees the note-covered reflection in a mirror, gasps, then sneezes the notes onto the cabinet. Pip is relieved but the cabinet stays messy.

alternatives.title: Pip mirror reveal
alternatives.text: Pip the rabbit wants to mark a toy cabinet, but a sticky note catches on Pip's finger. Pip tries to remove it; both hands now carry a note. Pulling doubles the notes repeatedly and covers Pip. The mirror reveals the mess, and a startled gasp turns into a sneeze. The cabinet catches the flying notes, leaving Pip relieved beside a messy cabinet.
